title: Print Bench
sub: Example designs from the claude-kit 3D printing folder, in their print colours. Drag to turn, pinch or scroll to zoom. The square under a print is a 270 x 270 mm bed.
foot: Built with 3d-printing/tools/print_bench.py from github.com/kalmehdar/claude-kit. Grams are an estimate from the shape (1 mm walls, 15% infill), about 20% either way; your slicer's figure wins.

models.name: Four-colour test card
models.for: The first print on a new multi-head printer. Every colour borders every other colour once; if the edges stay crisp, purge and retraction are right.
models.material: PETG, four heads: red, blue, white, black

models.name: Colour-coded Gridfinity bins
models.for: Eleven bins that fill a 5 x 5 Gridfinity tray, 42 mm tall, each name printed into a band in its category colour: red power, blue network, white storage, plain black for the rest.
models.status: Ready: prints as two plates, because the set plus a four-colour prime tower overflows a 270 mm bed
models.credit: Designed with Claude in OpenSCAD (models/gridfinity-bin.scad); Gridfinity is Zack Freedman's open standard

models.name: Clip-on cable tags
models.for: One tag per lead end, the colour saying what the lead carries and the ID printed in. Each clip is sized to its own cable, from mains down to slim Cat6: measure yours and set LEADS.
models.status: Fit first: print one tag per cable type and check it snaps on
